This likely explains why the test `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet` failed for the entry `"META-INF/maven/"`, as the Unix mode check in the `ZipArchiveEntry` class detected the `LINK_FLAG` among other flags, causing the assertion to fail.
